subject: Question about courier packing service
text:
Hi,

I need some information about the courier packing service your office used last term. I am not sure how it works, and I do not want to guess before our club sends boxes across town.

Could you tell me what sizes of boxes are available? Do you have small mailers as well as larger cartons? Are the cartons strong enough for framed prints? I would like to know if bubble wrap and tape are supplied with the service or sold separately.

Please also explain how the pickup process works. Does someone come to the building, or do we need to carry the boxes to a central desk? What is the earliest reliable pickup time on a Wednesday? If we miss that time, will the shipment go on the next day?

The pricing is important. Is there a student rate, or a discount for club deliveries? Could you send a sample price sheet? If the service charges per box, per weight, or per zone, I need the details.

The one reason I am asking so carefully is that a similar service produced an unexpectedly good outcome last year. We asked only for basic packing help, yet the staff also corrected our fragile labels and saved a damaged frame before it left the desk.

Could you send the booking link, current rules, and any form we should complete? Please include the contact person who confirms pickup dates, because the office email was not useful. That would help us plan the pickup.
